purpose: Test whether V119's all-player service construction used a moving alternative-prefix anchor baseline that was inconsistent with its final independent anchor replay; align the construction baseline with the exact anchor prefix without changing any coefficient, filter, scenario gate, or final certificate.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.observed_result: V119 passed four of nine gates: all three spike gates and sustained throughput. Sustained QPR means improved by 0.945% but only one paired seed improved; pulse throughput and QPR means fell 6.239% and 3.417%.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.mechanism_coverage: V119 evaluated 24,332 all-player service choices with zero unavailable inputs and made 526 substitutions split across 244 critical and 282 noncritical players. Its final independent replay compared 24,332 players, rejected 164 windows, and found 1,085 worse player comparisons.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.causal_gap: During native-order construction, V119 computes both the anchor-node proxy and candidate-node proxies in the evolving alternative prefix. Earlier substitutions therefore move the nominal anchor baseline. The final certificate instead compares independent exact-anchor and alternative prefixes, exposing a baseline mismatch.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Use an independently replayed exact-anchor prefix only for each player's anchor admitted-work service baseline. Continue to compute candidate proxies in the evolving alternative prefix and retain every V119 filter and final all-player replay.

closed_axes.service_choice_scope: every current player remains bit-for-bit V119
closed_axes.admitted_work_definition: pending plus all resident remaining plus same-window projected immutable CPU remains bit-for-bit V113-V119
closed_axes.complete_componentwise_scope: all current players remains bit-for-bit V118-V119
closed_axes.interference_constraints: disabled exactly as V113 and V118-V119
closed_axes.arrival_phase_guard: disabled exactly as V113 and V118-V119

hypothesis.primary: A service choice cannot be interpreted as a 10% improvement over the anchor when earlier candidate substitutions have already changed the state used to evaluate that anchor node. An exact-anchor prefix supplies the invariant baseline already used by the final replay.
hypothesis.candidate: Maintain two deterministic prefix states in frozen native player order. Add each exact anchor placement only to the anchor prefix and each selected placement only to the alternative prefix. Evaluate the anchor-node admitted-work proxy in the anchor prefix and candidate-node proxies in the alternative prefix; require the existing 9/10 ratio and all frozen V119 safety filters, then apply the unchanged complete all-player replay.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass all nine frozen throughput/QPR gates on the complete fresh E929-E931 cohort.

allowed: the exact V119 immutable/current-state inputs and native player order
the exact anchor assignment already constructed from the current state
an independently accumulated exact-anchor prefix and the evolving alternative prefix
the frozen 9/10 admitted-work service rule and complete all-player replay
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, registered burst interval, or time-to-burst-boundary
any E926-E928 result-derived threshold, margin, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap, player class, or smoothing width
formal E01-E20 outcome-dependent selection or confirmation outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.construction_definition: Before each current player is added, compute its anchor-node proxy from the independent exact-anchor prefix and candidate proxies from the independent alternative prefix. The candidate must satisfy the exact existing 9/10 integer-ratio test against the anchor-prefix proxy and every frozen V119 filter.
information_boundary.componentwise_definition: After construction, every current player's alternative proxy must remain no greater than its exact-anchor proxy plus the existing EPSILON under independent native-order replay.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any unavailable prefix input, infeasible prefix addition, incomplete assignment, replay mismatch, or failed V119 certificate preserves the exact anchor assignment.

arms.complete_all_player_service_rule: every current player's alternative admitted-work service proxy is no greater than its exact-anchor proxy

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Replace V119's same-alternative-prefix anchor service baseline with an independent exact-anchor prefix baseline during all-player construction.
candidate_mechanism.unchanged_final_certificate: Retain the complete V118/V119 all-current-player componentwise replay and every V113/V119 certificate.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without complete finite dual-prefix choice and replay evidence plus every frozen V119 certificate, dispatch exact V94 for identical state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V119 causal-arrival, admitted-work, service-choice, score, welfare, assignment-hash, feasibility, and componentwise replay fields
dual-prefix enabled flag, exact-anchor prefix target/evaluated/unavailable counts, alternative prefix target/evaluated/unavailable counts, and cross-prefix substitution counts
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V120 profile
